description: Returns an estimation of gas for a given transaction.

sub_parameters.name: from
sub_parameters.description: The address from which the transaction is sent

sub_parameters.name: to
sub_parameters.description: The address to which the transaction is addressed

sub_parameters.name: gas
sub_parameters.description: The integer of gas provided for the transaction execution

sub_parameters.name: gasPrice
sub_parameters.description: The integer of gasPrice used for each paid gas encoded as hexadecimal

sub_parameters.name: value
sub_parameters.description: The integer of value sent with this transaction encoded as hexadecimal

sub_parameters.name: data
sub_parameters.description: The hash of the method signature and encoded parameters. For more information, see the Contract ABI description in the Solidity documentation.

parameters.name: blockNumber
parameters.description: The block number in hexadecimal format or the string latest, earliest, pending, safe or finalized

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The state override set with address-to-state mapping where each address maps to an object containing

sub_parameters.name: balance
sub_parameters.description: Fake balance to set for the account before executing the call

sub_parameters.name: nonce
sub_parameters.description: Fake nonce to set for the account before executing the call

sub_parameters.name: code
sub_parameters.description: Fake EVM bytecode to inject into the account before executing the call

sub_parameters.name: state
sub_parameters.description: Fake key-value mapping to override all slots in the account storage before executing the call

sub_parameters.name: stateDiff
sub_parameters.description: Fake key-value mapping to override individual slots in the account storage before executing the call

quantity.description: The estimated amount of gas used
